mapper.select: SELECT bill.id, bill.channel_id, bill.settle_month, bill.settle_amount, bill.bill_detail_url,bill.bill_detail_file_name, bill.settle_status, bill.enterprise_id, bill.deleted, bill.create_time,bill.create_by,bill.update_by,bill.update_time FROM employee_channel_bill bill WHERE bill.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND bill.deleted = 1 ORDER BY bill.settle_month DESC, bill.create_time DESC, id DESC
